events.what_happened: The House of Lords ruled that UK local authorities had no power to enter swaps, voiding contracts with 137 councils (Hammersmith alone did 613 swaps). Banks wrote off about GBP 600m.
events.loss_components: write-offs across banks of void swap contracts
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.process_step: Client & counterparty onboarding, capacity and limits
events.validation_failed: Banks did not verify that local-authority clients had legal capacity to enter swaps; 600+ contracts void.
events.fit_reason: Any public-sector, municipal or special-purpose client: capacity and authorised signatories.

events.firm: Six Korean banks (KIKO FX options to SMEs)
events.what_happened: Knock-in/knock-out FX options sold to small exporters in 2007-08 caused about USD 1bn of client losses; in 2019 the FSS ordered six banks to compensate KRW 25.5bn.
events.loss_components: dispute-mediation compensation (Shinhan 15bn, Woori 4.2bn, KDB 2.8bn, Hana 1.8bn, Daegu 1.1bn, Citi Korea 0.6bn)
events.process_step: Client & counterparty onboarding, capacity and limits
events.validation_failed: FX option hedges sold to exporters in excess of their real FX exposure; banks compensated clients.
events.fit_reason: Client FX options and forwards: hedge size vs underlying exposure. Front-office led, back office can flag.

events.what_happened: Merrill provided over USD 500m of credit and trading facilities that a client's trader used to build a dominant copper position; CFTC penalty USD 15m.
events.process_step: Client & counterparty onboarding, capacity and limits
events.validation_failed: Credit and trading facilities given to a client trader without checking activity against the client's mandate.
events.fit_reason: Client trader acting beyond mandate; corporate treasury clients.

events.what_happened: The hedge of a client index-linked structured bond was repositioned and registered wrongly in December 2005; the unhedged position went unnoticed for weeks and cost EUR 20m.
events.loss_components: trading loss on the unhedged position
events.validation_failed: Hedge of a client structured bond re-registered wrongly; unhedged for weeks.
events.fit_reason: Exactly the back-to-back risk: client deal and hedge not matched daily.

events.what_happened: Structured certificates offered at a fraction of their value (EUR 108 instead of EUR 54,400).
events.validation_failed: Structured certificate parameters keyed without a check; sold to clients at a fraction of value.
events.fit_reason: Structured products for clients: term-sheet vs booking check.

events.what_happened: Trader Juan Pablo Davila keyed a buy as a sell, then traded to recoup it, multiplying the loss.
events.validation_failed: Buy keyed as a sell; no check of the booking against the order.
events.fit_reason: Wrong direction on a hedge leg leaves the bank double exposed instead of flat.

events.what_happened: Structured trades (long-term repos on government bonds with interest rate swaps) were used to hide earlier losses and booked as separate trades; restatement of about EUR 730m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Repo and interest rate swap booked as separate trades though contractually linked.
events.fit_reason: Linked trades in own risk-management positions.

events.what_happened: Inadequate front- and middle-office controls over fixed-income trade entry let a trader book a trade between funds at an off-market price; FCA fine GBP 6m.
events.validation_failed: Trade between client funds booked at an off-market price; no price check at entry.

events.what_happened: Issued ~$17.6bn of structured notes beyond its SEC shelf registration; rescission offer to buyers. SEC settlement $361m (plus rescission costs booked separately).
events.validation_failed: Structured notes issued above the registered amount; no automated limit check.
events.fit_reason: Applies if the bank issues notes; for a distributor, the issuance check sits with the issuer.

events.what_happened: A trader booked hundreds of fictitious trades over about 18 months; controls failed to detect them; FCA fine GBP 13.0m.
events.validation_failed: Hundreds of fictitious trades not caught by trade validation.
events.fit_reason: Same validation on a smaller book.

events.what_happened: Joseph Jett booked ~$350m of fictitious profits from forward recon of Treasury strips; profits reversed.
events.validation_failed: System booked profit on unsettled forward trades.

events.what_happened: Matthew Taylor built an unauthorised $8.3bn S&P e-mini futures position hidden by fake trade entries.
events.validation_failed: Manual trade entries not reconciled to the exchange.

events.what_happened: At times lacked effective controls to ensure the integrity of its input data to a benchmark administrator (EU Benchmarks Regulation); BaFin fine EUR 8.66m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Benchmark input data contributed by the bank not controlled.

events.what_happened: John Rusnak hid FX option losses with fictitious offsetting options at Allfirst, Baltimore.
events.validation_failed: Fictitious FX options never confirmed with counterparties; revaluation rates taken from the trader.
events.fit_reason: Small FX desk at a regional bank: the closest match to a bank with small own positions.

events.what_happened: Copper trader Yasuo Hamanaka's unauthorised positions on the LME over ~10 years.
events.validation_failed: Client's trader dealt off-book; confirmations went to the trader, not to independent staff.
events.fit_reason: Send client confirmations to someone independent of the dealer.

events.what_happened: Jerome Kerviel built ~EUR 50bn of hidden index-futures positions; loss crystallised when unwinding.
events.validation_failed: Fictitious forwards with 'pending' counterparties; alerts not escalated.

events.what_happened: Options trader Kyriacos Papouis mispriced interest-rate options using wrong volatilities.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Swaption volatilities supplied by the trader.
events.fit_reason: Unhedged swaption, cap or floor residuals.

events.what_happened: Four FX options traders hid losses with false trades and mismarked revaluations.
events.validation_failed: FX option revaluation rates supplied by the desk.
events.fit_reason: Residual FX option risk after back-to-back hedging.

events.what_happened: FX traders allegedly mismarked emerging-market currency options to hide losses of USD 100-140m; traders dismissed.
events.validation_failed: Illiquid EM FX option volatilities marked by traders.
events.fit_reason: Residual FX option risk; illiquid currency pairs.

events.what_happened: Natural-gas options book overvalued using prices from a colluding broker.
events.validation_failed: Prices verified against one colluding broker.

events.what_happened: A handful of traders deliberately mispriced asset-backed securities; the bank wrote down USD 2.85bn days after announcing results. FSA fine GBP 5.6m for systems and controls failures.
events.loss_components: write-down 2,850 (not all an operational loss) + FSA fine GBP 5.6m
events.validation_failed: Trader marks on ABS not challenged.

events.what_happened: Credit trader Matthew Piper mismarked credit-index options.
events.validation_failed: Option marks not verified.

events.what_happened: Overvalued equity-derivatives trading book; bank lost licence.
events.validation_failed: Derivatives valued by traders.

events.what_happened: Synthetic credit portfolio losses; positions mismarked and VaR model changed; fines $920m in 2013.
events.loss_components: trading loss 6,200 + fines 920 (SEC, OCC, Fed, FCA)
events.validation_failed: Marks at the edge of bid-offer; spreadsheet model error.

events.firm: FXCM (client losses after Swiss franc unpeg)
events.what_happened: When the Swiss National Bank removed the EUR/CHF floor, client FX losses exceeded their collateral and FXCM was left with up to USD 225m of negative balances, needing a USD 300m rescue. Banks were also hit (Deutsche Bank about USD 150m and Citi over USD 150m reported).
events.validation_failed: Client margin did not cover a currency gap; client losses exceeded collateral.
events.fit_reason: Client FX forwards and options on credit lines: gap-risk and margin on a peg or managed currency.

events.firm: Interactive Brokers (client losses after Swiss franc unpeg)
events.what_happened: Clients' leveraged FX positions went into deficit when the franc jumped; about USD 120m of client losses fell on the broker.
events.validation_failed: Client margin set for normal volatility.
events.fit_reason: Same as above; retail broker setting.

events.what_happened: Mistaken EUR 28bn transfer to an account at Eurex during a routine operation; recalled.
events.validation_failed: Collateral transfer sent with the wrong amount (EUR 28bn); recalled.

events.what_happened: Archegos default on total-return swaps; losses $5.5bn. Fed and PRA fines $387m (2023).
events.validation_failed: Static margin and repeated limit breaches on a client not enforced.
events.fit_reason: Client limit breaches tolerated; scale is prime brokerage.

events.what_happened: Regulators closed Herstatt after the German business day; counterparties that had paid Deutsche marks never received the US dollars. The origin of the term 'Herstatt risk' and of CLS settlement.
events.loss_components: counterparty losses not published as one figure
events.validation_failed: Principal paid away before the counter-currency arrived (no PvP).
events.fit_reason: FX settled outside CLS with counterparties and clients.

events.what_happened: On the day Lehman filed for bankruptcy, KfW's systems still released its leg of a currency swap to Lehman (reported EUR 300-350m); the counter-payment never came. The finance minister called it a failure of risk management.
events.loss_components: payment to a defaulted counterparty (reports range EUR 300-350m; total damage estimated up to EUR 536m)
events.validation_failed: FX-swap leg released to a counterparty already in default.
events.fit_reason: Interbank FX and FX swaps: stop payments on a credit event.

events.what_happened: Junior FX staff entered a gross instead of net amount, sending ~$6bn to a hedge fund; returned next day.
events.validation_failed: Gross instead of net amount sent; four-eye check missing.

events.what_happened: Paid ~$894m of its own money to Revlon lenders instead of $7.8m interest; ~$500m initially unrecovered, later recovered on appeal (2022). OCC fined $400m in 2020 for risk-control weaknesses.
events.loss_components: OCC fine 400 (wider control failings); payment later recovered
events.validation_failed: Principal paid instead of interest via manual override; three approvers passed it.
events.fit_reason: Loan and deposit payments to clients.

events.what_happened: A scheduling error re-ran a payment file on Christmas Day: about 75,000 payments for 2,000 corporate clients sent twice, GBP 130m from Santander's own funds; recovery from other banks took weeks.
events.loss_components: recovery effort; final loss not disclosed
events.validation_failed: Payment batch released twice.

events.what_happened: Client account credited with $81 trillion instead of $280; reversed within hours (reported as a 'near miss').
events.validation_failed: Amount with extra zeros passed two approvers.

events.what_happened: About $1.6bn of segregated customer funds missing at bankruptcy, used for firm liquidity; later recovered by customers.
events.validation_failed: Client money moved out of segregated accounts under liquidity stress.

events.what_happened: Kweku Adoboli's unauthorised ETF/index futures positions on the Delta One desk; FSA fine GBP 29.7m (~$48m).
events.validation_failed: Forward-settling trades never settled; not chased.

events.what_happened: Attackers used the bank's SWIFT credentials to send $951m of transfers from its New York Fed account; $81m went through, mostly to Philippine casinos.
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT messages from the bank's own terminal; statements not reviewed in time.

events.what_happened: Attackers used stolen SWIFT credentials to send fraudulent transfers via Wells Fargo; about USD 12m lost.
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT transfers with stolen credentials.

events.what_happened: Malware sent fraudulent SWIFT transfers of nearly USD 60m; most was recovered (about USD 0.5m lost).
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT transfers sent by malware.

events.what_happened: A wiper attack disabled 9,000 computers as cover while fraudulent SWIFT transfers of about USD 10m went to Hong Kong.
events.validation_failed: Fraudulent SWIFT transfers during a wiper attack.

events.firm: Bank of Ireland Private Banking (cyber fraud)
events.what_happened: 2014 cyber fraud exposed weak cyber security and controls over third-party payments and client asset safeguarding; Central Bank of Ireland fine EUR 1.66m.
events.validation_failed: Third-party payment instructions not verified.

events.what_happened: A USD 3.5m transfer was executed on a computer-generated instruction with a non-matching signature, confirmed with a third party rather than the account holder; the Swiss Supreme Court held the bank grossly negligent and liable for two thirds.
events.validation_failed: Client instruction executed without call-back to the account holder; signature mismatch ignored.

events.what_happened: Attackers tried to send about USD 110m; a technician reconciling SWIFT confirmations against payment orders spotted the mismatch and the transfers were stopped.
events.validation_failed: Control that WORKED: SWIFT confirmations reconciled to payment orders caught USD 110m.

events.what_happened: Staff issued fraudulent letters of undertaking over SWIFT for years; the SWIFT system was not linked to core banking, so the commitments never appeared in the books and nostro reconciliation did not flag them. About USD 1.77bn.
events.loss_components: PNB honoured the letters of undertaking to other banks
events.validation_failed: SWIFT commitments not reconciled to core banking; nostro breaks not escalated.
events.fit_reason: SWIFT vs core banking vs nostro.

events.what_happened: Nick Leeson hid losses on Nikkei futures and options in error account 88888; bank collapsed.
events.validation_failed: Funding requests not reconciled to positions; one person in front and back office.

events.what_happened: Toshihide Iguchi concealed US Treasury bond losses for 11 years by selling custody securities; bank expelled from US and fined $340m.
events.validation_failed: Trader controlled settlement and custody records.
events.fit_reason: Segregation of duties in a small office.

events.what_happened: Failed to segregate client money ($1.9bn-$23bn) in its futures and options business, Dec 2002-Jul 2009; FSA fine GBP 33.3m.
events.validation_failed: Client money in house accounts after a systems change.

events.firm: Bank of New York Mellon (FX pricing)
events.what_happened: Standing-instruction FX for custody clients priced at the worst rates of the day while told 'best execution'; $714m settlements.
events.validation_failed: FX rates applied to custody clients differed from what clients were told.

events.what_happened: Indirect FX for custody clients marked up beyond disclosures; $530m settlements with DOJ, SEC, DOL and class action.
events.validation_failed: FX rates applied to custody clients differed from what clients were told.

events.what_happened: Overcharged clients on bond and structured-product trades (2008-2017) through undisclosed spreads; SFC fine HK$400m plus ~US$25.2m compensation.
events.validation_failed: Spreads on bond and structured-product trades not checked against client agreements.

events.what_happened: Group kept price improvements on client FX orders instead of passing them on (2006-2010); FCA fine GBP 4m.
events.validation_failed: Price improvements kept from clients; asymmetric slippage.

events.what_happened: Over 40m swaps under- or misreported since 2017; CFTC $15m.
events.validation_failed: FX forwards reported as spot; collateral flags wrong.
events.fit_reason: EMIR reporting of client FX forwards.

events.what_happened: Over 40m swaps under- or misreported, including FX spot/forward misclassification (2017-2023); CFTC penalty $15m.
events.validation_failed: Over 40m swaps misreported (FX classification).

events.what_happened: Over 20m swaps reported late or wrongly and 1m+ mid-market marks wrong or missing; CFTC $30m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Over 20m swaps back-reported.

events.what_happened: Nearly 4m swaps unreported or misreported, mainly allocation errors (since 2015); CFTC penalty $8m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Allocation errors in swap reports.

events.firm: Bank of New York Mellon (swap reporting)
events.what_happened: At least 5m swaps misreported (2018-2023), partly breaching a 2019 consent order; weak supervision of communications; CFTC penalty $5m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Swaps misreported, breaching an earlier order.

events.firm: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (swap reporting)
events.what_happened: Repeated late reporting of swap data to a swap data repository since 2017; CFTC penalty $1.25m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Swap data reported late.

events.what_happened: Millions of swaps reported wrongly or late (duplicate identifiers, wrong economic terms, time stamps) 2018-2023; CFTC penalty $4m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Swaps reported wrongly or late.

events.firm: DZ Bank (swaps keyed wrongly in system migration)
events.what_happened: When DG Bank moved to a new trading and risk system in 1999, zero-coupon interest rate swaps were keyed in wrongly; the mismatch inflated profits for about four years until a swap matured. Loss EUR 40m plus a write-down of over EUR 100m.
events.product: Interest rate derivatives (swaps, swaptions, caps, floors)
events.validation_failed: Swaps keyed wrongly in a system migration; not reconciled until a swap matured.
events.fit_reason: Migration of client and hedge swaps: reconcile cash flows trade by trade.

events.what_happened: A configuration error made during maintenance of the SWIFT payment system caused payments to four banks to be sent repeatedly (press: about EUR 5bn); the duplicates were returned.
events.validation_failed: SWIFT configuration change sent payments in a loop.

events.what_happened: During a remittance-system update, incoming interbank transfers that had failed were credited to customers as normal deposits for 30 minutes; KRW 32.5bn credited, KRW 7.3bn still being recovered.
events.validation_failed: After an update, failed incoming transfers were credited as received.

events.what_happened: Software counter overflow in the government-securities clearing system; bank borrowed $23.6bn overnight from the Fed (interest ~$5m).
events.loss_components: interest cost ~5 (below threshold; kept as iconic near miss)
events.validation_failed: Untested field limit broke securities settlement.

Client & counterparty onboarding, capaci.validation: Before the first deal: legal capacity and authorised signatories, ISDA/CSA in place, credit line, and hedge size vs the client's real exposure.
Client & counterparty onboarding, capaci.scenario: A client (municipality, SME or corporate treasury) disputes or cannot honour derivative deals because it lacked capacity or authority, or the hedge was larger than its exposure.

Trade capture & back-to-back matching.validation: Every client deal has a matching hedge (same notional, dates, strike, direction) and both match the term sheet; mismatches are flagged the same day.
Trade capture & back-to-back matching.scenario: A client FX option or structured product is hedged with a wrong leg (direction, notional or barrier), and the bank is unhedged until a fixing or maturity.

Confirmation & matching.validation: Client and counterparty confirmations are sent and matched by staff independent of the dealer; unconfirmed trades are aged and escalated.
Confirmation & matching.scenario: Unconfirmed client or interbank deals pile up; a fictitious or disputed trade is found months later.

Independent price verification.validation: Residual own positions and the client/hedge pairs are revalued with independent rates and volatilities.
Independent price verification.scenario: A small own FX option or swaption position is marked by the desk; independent revaluation forces a write-down.

Collateral, margin & credit limits.validation: Client exposures on forwards and options are compared with credit lines and collateral daily, with gap-risk stress for pegged currencies.
Collateral, margin & credit limits.scenario: A sudden currency move (like the 2015 Swiss franc unpeg) leaves client losses above collateral and credit lines, and clients default.

Payment release & settlement.validation: Payments are released after four-eye checks, duplicate and amount-limit checks, and are stopped for counterparties in default.
Payment release & settlement.scenario: An FX or money-market payment goes out with the wrong amount, twice, or to a counterparty that defaulted that morning.

Payment instruction verification & messa.validation: Client instructions and changes to settlement instructions are verified by call-back; SWIFT access is secured and messages matched to approved orders.
Payment instruction verification & messa.scenario: A fraudster changes a client's settlement instructions or sends SWIFT messages from the bank's own terminal.

Nostro & cash reconciliation.validation: Nostro statements and SWIFT traffic are reconciled to the books the same day; breaks are aged and escalated.
Nostro & cash reconciliation.scenario: Breaks on a nostro are left open and a fraud or payment error builds up for weeks.

Client rates, charges & interest.validation: Rates, spreads and interest charged to clients are checked against the agreed terms.
Client rates, charges & interest.scenario: Client FX spreads or interest are charged above agreement for years, leading to restitution and fines.

Regulatory trade reporting.validation: EMIR/CFTC reports are reconciled to the books, including product classification (spot vs forward).
Regulatory trade reporting.scenario: Years of client FX forwards are misreported, leading to back-reporting and a fine.

System change & static data.validation: Changes and migrations of payment and derivatives systems are tested and reconciled trade by trade and cash flow by cash flow.
System change & static data.scenario: A payment-system or swaps-system change duplicates payments or migrates client and hedge cash flows wrongly.
